name: Sr'ral Dulss

facts.text: Sr'ral Dulss as the condottieri's paymaster is Living Server writing.

story:
The drakoran legion does not do all its own fighting in the dales. It hires. The condottieri of the western ground are sell-swords of the legion's lesser clans, with medics to keep them working and mystics to keep them honest, and Sr'ral Dulss pays them.

Sr'ral Dulss keeps the purse and the roll, and is the only one of the company who knows exactly what each blade costs and what each has earned, and who will not be paid this season. The condottieri hate their paymaster as sell-swords always hate the one who holds the money, and they would cut that throat in a moment if the legion would let them. The legion will not, and so they stand round Sr'ral Dulss like a wall, because if anyone else killed their paymaster they would never see a coin again.

Gracien Adamson at the fort says that is the most honest arrangement in the dales.
legend: Sr'ral Dulss, level 39 drakoran, in the west of the dales with drakoran mystics (42), medics (40) and condottieri (40) around. No faction, but the camp is thick and aggressive: kill the mystics and medics first; nothing has spells in the data, but they are aggressive and close, and they all come. Plain melee, no spells. Respawn 80 seconds. Good named for the high thirties.
